principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class violates the Open/Closed Principle because every time a new shape type is added, the sum method must be modified to calculate this new shape's area.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce a common interface, e.g., "Shape", which includes a method to calculate the area. This way, new shapes can implement this interface with their specific logic, allowing the AreaCalculator class to remain unchanged.

principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator uses instance checking to differentiate between shapes, indicating a violation of Liskov Substitution Principle as it relies on the object type for logic execution.
principle_violations.suggestion: Implement a 'Shape' interface with an 'area' method in each shape class to allow polymorphic behavior, letting each shape class define its way of calculating area.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
